activity.role: General Secretary and de facto leader
activity.notes: Chernenko was elected General Secretary of the CPSU on 13 February 1984 and was the Soviet Union's top political leader until his death on 10 March 1985. He also became Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet in April 1984, but ATLAS uses one leadership Activity rather than duplicating overlapping top offices.

sources.title: Konstantin Ustinovich Chernenko — Encyclopedia of Russian History
sources.citation_text: The reference identifies Chernenko as Soviet leader and General Secretary from February 1984 until his death in March 1985.
